speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You present with fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests; to narrow down the cause, please tell me if you have noticed any jaundice (yellowing of your skin or eyes) or dark urine recently. Additionally, have you recently traveled to areas with schistosomiasis or eaten raw freshwater fish?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) or Hepatitis C infection. Given the history of ulcerative colitis, primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) is also a strong consideration.

I need to know if you have experienced any abdominal pain, specifically in the upper right quadrant, or if you have noticed pale, clay-colored stools. Also, have you ever been diagnosed with inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's or ulcerative colitis) or had imaging of your bile ducts?

REQUEST TEST: ANTI-MITOCONDRIAL ANTIBODY (AMA), HEPATITIS C ANTIBODY, PCT (p-ANCA).
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound.
